text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Great prayers answered, boundless blessings invoked.
Our run in the Twinkle Series with Matikanefukukitaru was a resounding success.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Three tumultuous years came to an end, and I can finally
set down the burden. Just as I let out a sigh of relief...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa! Nobody called for me,
but here I am! Happiness is right by your side!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Have you Machikane-waited for me? You have, haven't you?
Machikane Fukukitaru is here now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Calling it 'business' is so cruel~! Trainer, you're
my destined one, so greet me with a face
overflowing with joy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You see~ Today, I wanted to take you to a power spot
as a way of saying thanks for everything so far.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: May many more wonderful things come your wayâlet me share some of my good fortune with you! May I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Swept along by the invitation, I decided to head out.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Look over there!
That beckoning cat standing in front of the izakaya!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's a rare one that used to be a tanuki before it got repainted.
It's very miraculous~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And this is the arcade of the gods, where you can easily snag the top prizes from crane games.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"If you keep inserting coins and still can't win it,
a kind arcade clerk will help you out."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: A God-tier arcade has God-tier staff service too, huh.
choice_data_list: All of them seem like pretty dubious power spots...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Awawa, okay, one last one! This final one is genuinely an extraordinary power spot!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Do you know about this shrine?
choice_data_list: This is the place we always used to visit, right?
This is the place we always came to, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yes. But actually, I realized that right here is the ultimate power spot.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: A new myth has been discovered recently...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Once upon a time, there was a young girl
at this shrine.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The young girl did not know how to make her wish come true,
and was at a complete loss.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
However, a divine messenger appeared there.
To grant the young girl's wish.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"God's messenger gave me a miraculous power.
The power to run across the Milky Way together and grasp the stars."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
See? Don't you think this place
is the ultimate power spot?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Word on the street is that the young girl
is super grateful to you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Matikane Fukukitaru
had come over to express her thanks.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Still, I think... the one that girl is most grateful to is probably..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that wasn't really what
made your dream come true.
choice_data_list: So, what are you giving thanks for?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: That's—giving me such a wonderful time!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Win or lose,
through good times and tough times alike...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No matter when, I was always so happy.
Truly, truly, I...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my mistake.
Not me, the young girl!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Things got a bit all over the place,
but yeah, that's the gist of it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
We can officially certify this as the ultimate power spot!
Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A power spot. Maybe power isn't something
that inherently dwells in a place from the start.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A single encounter eventually became a legend.
Thanks to Matikane Fukukitaru's success, this shrine became a special place.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer-san, shall we go?
That was all I wanted to talk about!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, this isn't a goodbye!
Because the thread connecting us is made of steel!
choice_data_list: That's fine, but... aren't you going to draw a fortune?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Coming all the way to a shrine and not drawing a fortune
just isn't like Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It's fine. Just for today.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's fine.
Come on, let's go get some sweet red bean soup!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
(Because...
I know the answer without even having to pull a fortune.)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
(Today is an auspicious day.
Because—)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: (Because the person I can share this happiness with is right beside me!)
